mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 52 degrees and partly cloudy near Fireman's Park under a full moon. Our air quality is currently at 67, and you can catch the ISS passing overhead tonight rising from the direction of Middleton near Verona High School toward Madison near Home Depot.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on November 4th at 6:30 p.m. to review proposed developments including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, property tax bills will arrive by mail no later than December 15, with options to pay in two installments.

Today, you can enjoy the Dane County Farmer's Market or live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness this Sunday, followed by various trivia nights at local spots like Hop Haus and The Bogey Factory starting next week.

On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I following a report of dangerous driving behavior while students were on board. The investigation determined the driver was impaired, and the department is asking anyone with information to come forward.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open today at 10:00 AM.
